records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Mia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Vantage Dynamics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:e1b516c1], [email:d7a9c444]) — no signal of customer engagement. Starter plan, silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Vantage Dynamics project started
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Following up on my welcome note last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, the quickest first step is usually creating one project and adding a few real tasks to it — the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you, so it's set up the way your team actually works.

Best,
Priya
